_comment: Runs after glitch-square.json, which baked the 27-degree skew out of the model. The part map guessed Glitch's drum axle as a clean transverse [1,0,0]; a covariance fit over the drum's own vertices put it at [0.4483, 0.0567, -0.8921] before the bake and [0.9984, 0.0567, 0.0003] after, which is the check that the bake did what it claimed. The loader spins the mesh about extras.weaponAxis, so before this the drum was turning about a line it is not mounted on and wobbled instead of spinning.
